gr_provenance.tgr: arXiv2607.19293 section2 pp3-4 + Tables2-3 pp4-5: standard GW-catalog PE source properties
gr_provenance.catalog: LIGO-P2600152-v6 section3 p12: baseline analyses before GR tests; standard IMR waveform families, default prior and median/90% intervals
gr_provenance.conclusion: GR IMR baseline quantities, not estimates with dtau deformation fitted; not inspiral-only or statistically independent of the same strain
gr_provenance.mass_frame: Detector/redshifted remnant mass (1+z)Mf directly from TGR table, not source mass or product of medians
gr_provenance.spin_type: Dimensionless remnant final spin chi_f, not chi_eff
gr_provenance.parser_warning: Historical Mdet field is REDSHIFTED CHIRP mass, not total or remnant mass. Use Mf_det only for proposed remnant-mass cut

proposal_INPUT_only.uncertainty: Point-median proposal only; no credible-bound or probability rule chosen. Some mass intervals cross 40.

fit_review_scope.note: Inherited convention.sigma_fit_performed=false describes original metadata artifact, not this fit; root status explicitly says planning fit
